official_attack_type: Guard; Clashable Guard, 1 Unbreakable coin (provided kit)
mapping_evidence: Separated demonstration and matching impact count; see segments.json for evidence and alternative mapping.

weapon.type: Broad rectangular greatsword/slab blade, visually confirmed; no separate physical tower shield resolved.
weapon.parts: Broad squared/beveled tip, thick pale metallic perimeter, dark inset central panel, small yellow-green rectangular inset near base, dark grip/guard. Edge-on views can look like a rod.
weapon.grip: Both gauntleted hands appear clustered on/near grip in sweep close-ups; overhead poses visibly have both arms raised. Hand overlap and motion blur prevent finger-level grip identification.
weapon.held_positions: Low diagonal blade pointing behind/left during ready pose; broad blade behind shoulder during sweep follow-through; raised behind/above head for slams.
weapon.limitations: Dimensions and hex values are estimates from compressed video. Large apparent size changes mostly come from camera punches, not weapon growth.
weapon.skill_specific: Physical rectangular blade remains visible low to caster left during guard establishment and between impacts; some upright guard poses obscure it. Gold shield has translucent field and graphic concentric outline, not a resolved solid carried tower shield. No weapon swap is proved.

props.origin: Appears immediately in front/right of caster at guard establishment; follows guard pose, not thrown.
props.path: Stationary relative to caster, vertical plane facing enemy/right. Slight perspective curvature; resets with shot fades.
props.shape: Rounded/angular shield outline containing nested long U/panel contours; translucent curved oval/half-oval gold field extends behind outline.
props.limitations: 713–714 brief initial appearance; 715 dims; from 716 sustained. Other brief dimming/reset intervals listed in beats. No independent physical shield rim/handle can be resolved.

props.origin: Appear directly around opponent after guard flare; no flight from caster.
props.path: Outer and inner yellow circular outlines expand/pulse around target body then fade.
props.interpretation: Likely Tremor/guard-clash result visual; not a fired projectile, not evidence of an additional damage coin.

caster_motion.description: Crouches/braces, blade low, shield graphic flickers into place.
Mostly planted; changes body angle/brace after enemy sweep.
Raises torso/blade slightly, braces for second enemy sweep.
Shield brightens; caster remains behind it. Zoom dominates apparent size and movement.
Shot fades/resets to wider incoming opponent action.
Brief transparency, shield restored; no resolved counter-travel.
Another dim reset, upright guard restored, receives final enemy swing.

beats.description: Hard change to darker gameplay shot; caster lowers/braces.
Gold shield appears.
One dim frame with shield mostly absent.
Barrier returns; opponent approaches then holds low wind-up.
Enemy crescent into shield; orange impact, expanding ring, black/white overhead glyph. Crescent and ring fade.
Opponent recovery and shield hold.
Opponent advances/repositions; caster braces upright.
Two-frame white star at shield.
Orange star/ring and enemy crescent thin; shield remains.
Three bright close-up frames: upright gold field and fine wavering contour.
Shield outline visible with floating white flakes and thin horizontal gold line.
White flare and black glyph at 810, white/orange star at 811.
Two yellow circles appear directly around enemy; orange shield ring and glyph persist.
Rings disappear; overhead glyph fades by ≈847; guard holds.
One dim mixed frame.
Wider shot and low enemy approach.
Orange barrier hit, gold opponent crescent, orange ring and small black/white glyph.
No new hit.
Three frames of transparent/dim figures and no bright shield.
Barrier restored; no additional contact spark.
Five dim frames before gold barrier returns; enemy reappears during transition.
Caster braces, opponent rises into swing.
Large curling textured gold crescent from enemy, white contact star, red/orange sparks and ground dust.
Crescent gone, caster still behind shield; cut to white outro at 953.

effects.fade: No continuous 8-second fade; short resets at 715,851,887–889,914–918. Ends on outro cut.

conventions: Zero-based source frame indices; intervals are [start,end). Seconds use decoded PTS, not rounded sheet labels. Nominal 30 fps has millisecond PTS rounding.
limitations: Contact proxy is the first impact spark/flash, not verified game damage timing. Cropping and opaque VFX hide some physical contacts; uncertainty intervals are recorded. Camera and effect event boundaries refer to observed source frames.

H = visible upright character height, excluding weapon/hair overshoot. Distances, effect dimensions and colors are visual estimates, not calibrated world coordinates. Do not treat zoom-induced apparent displacement as a dash.

Classify motion/contact, not long bright streak shape alone. Sweeps here stay tied to a held weapon; no detached traveling projectile or sustained beam is resolved. Their oversized trails bridge stylized sprite spacing. Melee classifications for cropped contacts have medium confidence.
coin_comparison: 1 guard coin is not 1 offensive hit. Four clear opponent weapon-sweep contacts plus one separate guard-resolution flash are visible; do not call these five Ishmael coins.

evidence.description: Bright white field and black/white overhead glyph

guard_coin_resolution.contact: Shield-side flash rather than visible outgoing weapon hit. Target rings appear in place, without traveling projectile.
guard_coin_resolution.mechanic_interpretation: Consistent with Your Shield Clash Win/Tremor Burst from kit, but exact game resolution, damage and trigger cannot be proved without UI. Do not count another offensive coin or assert perfect-block timing.
